recipes.title: Bok Choy Chinese sauce
steps: Blanch bok choy with salt in boiled water, 1-2 min.
Mix the sauce: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1/4 tsp pepper, 1/2 tbsp sesame oil, 1/2 cup chicken stock, 1/2 tbsp corn starch.
Fry 10 cloves of minced garlic and add the sauce.

recipes.title: Fried Eggplant
steps: Cut the top of the eggplant off.
Air fry at 12 min, then cut in half after.
Make the sauce: garlic oil with garlic, oyster sauce, chili (optional), scallion, sugar, sesame oil.
Drizzle the sauce over the eggplant.
